observations: Photo 0 shows a white Nikon Coolpix S31 camera with a lens ring labeled 'NIKKOR 3X OPTICAL' and a sticker indicating 'Easy to use', 'Waterproof 5m/16.4ft', 'Wide 3X Zoom', 'Shockproof 1.2m/3.9ft'.
Photo 1 is a close-up of the lens and body, showing the same waterproof and shockproof text: 'WATERPROOF 5.0m/16.4ft SHOCKPROOF 1.2m/3.9ft'.

Photo 2 shows the rear of the camera with a small screen, a control dial, and buttons. The screen is off and appears dirty or smudged. The camera is held in a hand over a plastic bag with 'McSteve' branding.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.
No power cord, battery, or charger is visible in any photo.
The camera body appears intact with no visible cracks or major damage, but the screen is off and dirty.
